title: typha domingensis var. javanica
intro: Typha domingensis var. javanica, commonly known as Javanese cattail, is a plant species belonging to the cattail family (Typhaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Javanese cattail include analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Javanese cattail also exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
